Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Provides a scoped SPI connection during a synchronous Spi.Connect callback.
Operations require the owning backend callback and the innermost active session.

```csharp
public sealed class SpiSession
```

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

### Execute(SpiCommand)

Executes a parameterized command on this active scoped session.

```csharp
public long Execute(SpiCommand command)
```

Parameters:

`command` — [SpiCommand](/api/ankus.spicommand/)

SQL and its declared bindings.

Returns: [long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int64)

The final statement's processed row count.

Like pgrx's writable SPI helpers, the call first assigns the transaction an ID, even for a <code>SELECT</code>. A hot
standby can't assign one, and a later <code>DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY</code> in the same transaction fails, as it needs a
transaction without one. <code>Select</code> reads without assigning an ID.

<a id="member-3f3db5f8071d1fcf"></a>

### ExecuteScalars&lt;TFirst, TSecond&gt;(string, params ReadOnlySpan&lt;SpiParameter&gt;)

Reads the first two columns of the first row without limiting command execution.

### OpenCursor(string, params ReadOnlySpan&lt;SpiParameter&gt;)

Opens a transaction-bound cursor whose portal remains valid after this session ends.
Uses a read-only snapshot until the transaction becomes writable, then uses a fresh writable snapshot.

### Query(SpiCommand, bool, int)

Executes a parameterized command with explicit snapshot mode and a row limit.

```csharp
public SpiResult Query(SpiCommand command, bool readOnly = false, int limit = 0)
```

Parameters:

`command` — [SpiCommand](/api/ankus.spicommand/)

SQL and its declared bindings.

Whether to use read-only SPI execution; false first assigns the transaction an ID.

The maximum returned rows, or zero for unlimited.

helpers do, even for a <code>SELECT</code>. A hot standby can't assign one, and a later <code>DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY</code> in
the same transaction fails, as it needs a transaction without one. <code>Select</code> reads without assigning an ID.
